interpretation: Defect failures and strict xfails remain unresolved findings, never passing acceptance. Native preset runs are component tests, not simulator evidence.
redactionPolicy: All selected files are byte-for-byte originals. No redaction, rewriting or path normalization was applied. Original absolute paths are historical source locations, not links to all published attachments.

sensitiveDataReview.scope: All 42 selected UTF-8 JSON/XML/log/lcov/Markdown files and five Web failure PNG screenshots; omitted trace archives were not approved or copied.

sensitiveDataReview.manualVisualReview: Five existing Web failure screenshots show fixture-only application screens and no credentials; no native screenshots are included.
sensitiveDataReview.limits: Pattern scanning is not a universal secret detector. Candidate assignment matches were checked against test/seed sources; no environment dump, database or live credential was selected. Existing local workspace paths and machine hostname remain as non-secret provenance.
